title: Proposed study collaboration on SCN1A-related disorders

sentences.text: Invitation to discuss a research collaboration on SCN1A-related disorders, including Dravet syndrome
Dear Dravet Syndrome Foundation and Dravet Syndrome UK team, you both support families living with Dravet syndrome.
I am [name, role, institution], and I would value your view on a study idea.
Published work links SCN1A-related disorders mainly to loss of function, but this is contested, as a minority of variants act by gain of function.
Haploinsufficiency is also suggested, with lower confidence.
Simons Searchlight is a recruiting registry, natural history and biorepository that includes SCN1A.
ETX101 gene therapy trials are recruiting or active, and fenfluramine, cannabidiol and stiripentol are labelled for Dravet seizures.
Some sodium channel blockers worsened seizures in loss-of-function Dravet syndrome.
We would propose [study aim and design], built with families and run under ethics approval.

sections.heading: What we would ask of you

sentences.text: Would you be willing to discuss the idea, and how your community could take part with proper consent?
We are not asking for any names, contact details or records of patients or families.
If you are open to it, could we arrange a short call at a time that suits you?
